titleTr: Ne zamandır buradasın? for ve since

explainTr: Bir şey geçmişte başladı ve hâlâ devam ediyorsa Present Perfect kullanırsın: I have lived here for six years. İngilizcede 'I live here for six years' denmez.
for bir süre söyler: for two years, for six months, for a long time. since başlangıç noktası söyler: since 2019, since Monday, since I was a child.
Soru için How long + have/has + özne + V3 kullanılır: How long have you lived here? Cevap: For seven years. / Since 2019.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'altı yıldır buradayım' dersin ve şimdiki zaman kullanırsın. İngilizcede aynı cümle Present Perfect ister: 'I have been here for six years'. 'I am here for six years' yanlıştır.
table: for two years / for a week
I have worked here for two years.
How long have you lived here?
I haven't seen him since Friday.

reading.title: Seven years in Texas
reading.text:
Mr. Brown is writing a short welcome story for the school newsletter, and he asks Hafsa a few questions. "How long have you lived in the United States?" he asks.

"Since 2019," Hafsa answers. "It has been almost seven years."

At first, life here was difficult. Hafsa felt homesick, and she was nervous when she spoke English at the bank or the pharmacy. "My accent was strong, and people sometimes asked me to repeat," she remembers. But she did not give up. She has taken English classes for four years, and she has studied a little every day since the first winter.

Now she feels much more comfortable. She has known Linda since the first week in their building, and Linda has become a close friend. Hafsa has been a school volunteer for two years, and the children know her well. She has also learned to drive on American highways, which was the hardest challenge of all.

"What is your advice for new immigrants?" Mr. Brown asks.

Hafsa laughs. "Be patient. You haven't lived here long, so you don't know everything yet. Learn something new every day, and ask for help. People are kinder than you expect."

Mr. Brown writes her last sentence in big letters at the top of the page. "That is the best advice I have heard this year," he says.

script.speaker: Ms. Carter
script.text: Hi, you must be Hafsa. I'm Ms. Carter. Mr. Brown told me about you.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Nice to meet you. I'm a volunteer in the library.

script.speaker: Ms. Carter
script.text: How long have you volunteered here?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: For about two years. And you? How long have you taught at this school?

script.speaker: Ms. Carter
script.text: Since 2015. I teach fourth grade, and I love it.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That's a long time. I have lived in Texas since 2019, so I'm still learning.

script.speaker: Ms. Carter
script.text: Where did you live before that?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: In Isparta, in Turkey. I lived there for thirty-five years.

script.speaker: Ms. Carter
script.text: Wow. Do you feel comfortable here now?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Mostly, yes. My neighbor Linda has helped me a lot. We have been friends for six years.

script.speaker: Ms. Carter
script.text: That is wonderful. Are you free on Thursday? I need a helper for the reading hour.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, I'm available. I haven't missed a Thursday since September.

writing.promptTr: ABD'deki (ya da bir şehirdeki) hayatını anlatan kısa bir paragraf yaz (80-120 kelime). for ve since kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write a paragraph about your life in the United States. Use for and since.
writing.model:
I have lived in Texas since 2019. At first, life here was hard because I felt homesick, and my English was not good. I have studied English for four years, and I study a little every day. Now I feel more comfortable.

I have known my neighbor Linda since my first week here. She has helped me with many things. I have also volunteered at my son's school for two years. The children know me, and I love working with them. My accent is still strong, but people understand me. I hope to become a substitute teacher soon.
checklistTr: Süre için for (for two years), başlangıç noktası için since (since 2019) kullandın mı?
'I live here since' gibi hatalı kalıplardan kaçındın mı?
